conservation_T100.discrete_note: E_h, the exactly conserved semi-discrete energy (4th-order D2 form)
conservation_T100.physical_density_note: energy from the physical density (np.gradient phi_r, trapezoid in r^2 dr), the quadrature used for E_loc; its variation is O(dr^2) quadrature error of this diagnostic as the field moves on the grid, not non-conservation of the dynamics. It bounds the accuracy of E_loc fractions (~1e-4).
